prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a gaunt tall purple-grey undead standing hunched in a rotting pale burial shroud hanging in strips from its shoulders, very long thin arms reaching down past its knees ending in long bony fingers, a skull-like face with stretched skin and two large bright green glowing eye sockets (big enough to read at sprite size), a lipless grin of teeth, thin legs; in every cell the whole figure is centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its skull-like face with two bright glowing green eyes and a lipless grin is readable in every cell.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, lunging forward and reaching both long arms out toward the heroes, the shroud strips flying; the arms are bent at the elbows so the hands stop well before the right edge of the middle cell and never cross into the next cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, both long arms flung up and back over its head away from the heroes, the head thrown back, the shroud flapping, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso and extend the arms and the long fingers far from the body. Draw only the parts and clothing named in the description, the same in every cell: no cape, cloak, scarf or extra cloth beyond the shroud strips, which swing with the motion, and no slash trail, smear, motion arc or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a weapon, armour, a hood, a crouch on all fours, a cape.
